class.name: AttributeContainer
class.brief_description: A node container that stores, manages, and evaluates runtime attributes and active modifiers for an entity.
class.description: [AttributeContainer] serves as the runtime manager for a character's stats defined by an [AttributeSetData]. It maintains base and calculated values for attributes, manages the application and removal of [ModifierData] instances, handles dirty-state recalculations, and signals whenever stats or modifiers change.

method.name: _pre_attribute_change
method.description: Override this method to intercept attribute changes. This is useful to apply gameplay caps before the actual value changes. (Ex. [Attribute] "Health" cannot be higher than [Attribute] "MaxHealth". In this case, use this method to apply the limit instead of the calculated value if that is higher than allowed).

method.name: add_modifier
method.description: Applies a [ModifierData] instance to the attribute specified by [param attribute_id]. Returns an integer handle or index associated with the newly applied modifier.

method.name: get_attribute_base_value
method.description: Returns the un-modified base value for the attribute matching [param attribute_id].

method.name: get_attribute_current_value
method.description: Returns the calculated current value for the attribute matching [param attribute_id], accounting for all active modifiers.

method.name: is_attribute_dirty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the attribute specified by [param attribute_id] has pending modifications or requires a recalculation before its value can be read accurately.

method.name: is_attribute_max
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current value of the attribute specified by [param attribute_id] has reached or exceeded its defined maximum threshold.

method.name: is_attribute_min
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current value of the attribute specified by [param attribute_id] has dropped to or below its defined minimum threshold.

method.name: remove_modifier
method.description: Removes an active [ModifierData] instance from the target attribute specified by [param attribute_id] and triggers a recalculation.

members.member: The [AttributeSetData] resource template containing the default attributes and definitions managed by this container.

signal.name: attribute_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an attribute in this container has been modified.

signal.name: effect_added
signal.description: Emitted when a gameplay effect affecting [param attribute_name] is applied to the [param owner].

signal.name: effect_removed
signal.description: Emitted when an active gameplay effect affecting [param attribute_name] is removed from the [param owner].

signal.name: modifier_added
signal.description: Emitted when a new [ModifierData] instance is added to [param attribute_name] on the [param owner].

signal.name: modifier_removed
signal.description: Emitted when an existing [ModifierData] instance is removed from [param attribute_name] on the [param owner].
